pressure_hypothesis.refuted_by: on the closed straights P1 and P2, the target program's change between the pressure-default and pressure-elongation-on runs differs, beyond the screening profile, from the closed forms' change: each anchor's axial reaction changing by (1 - 2 nu) p A_i (P1), or the free end's axial displacement changing by (1 - 2 nu) p A_i L/(E A_s) (P2); or its axial results there do not change at all
pressure_hypothesis.statement: HYPOTHESIS, which the pressure-elongation-on series tests and does not assume: the target program's Bourdon effect switch, with Bourdon in the sustained load cases, corresponds on straight pipe to SWBPIPE's pressure elongation, the closed-end free pressure strain (1 - 2 nu) p A_i/(E A_s), applied in case:sustained. Nothing about the target program is stated beyond the format facts of its OPPRES record.

pressure-bend-opening.description: the closed cantilever L of P7 in its pressure-default and pressure-elongation-on runs. Pressure elongation does not turn the free end of a closed cantilever (build_p7), so SWBPIPE's change of that rotation between the runs is 0 and the target program's change isolates the bend opening of its Bourdon switch. The same pair of an anchored L (P4) does not isolate it: between anchors the legs' elongation bends the L and turns its ends too
pressure-bend-opening.observed: case:sustained rotation about Y of the free end node:B

pressure-bourdon-expansion-capture.description: the target program's alternative placement of Bourdon, captured only. No SWBPIPE state of these models equals it, since their expansion cases carry no pressure; its printed results are screened against nothing
pressure-bourdon-expansion-capture.mbf: the writer's output with its one OPPRES line 0,0,0,1,0 replaced by 0,1,0,1,0 (Bourdon effect on, pressure correction for bends off, Bourdon in the expansion load cases): not writer output, with its own hash (substituted_mbf_text)

pressure-closure-01.description: one pressurised cantilever with its anchor terminal transferring to the wall (closed) and separately supported or compensated (open): the same target-program input, since the MBF carries no terminal closure, with SWBPIPE's end thrust changed

pressure-default.description: Bourdon effect off on the target program's side; pressure elongation off on SWBPIPE's
pressure-default.swbpipe: the tracked model document as it is, without model_settings.pressure_elongation, solved on a build whose model document has that setting (absent, it solves with pressure elongation off)

pressure-elongation-on.description: Bourdon effect on, placed in the sustained load cases, against SWBPIPE's pressure elongation on in case:sustained. As far as the public page states, the fifth field at 1 places Bourdon in the target program's sustained and operating printed cases; pressure_elongation_convention is named on those cases (case:sustained and operating) and not on case:expansion
pressure-elongation-on.mbf: the writer's output with its one OPPRES line 0,0,0,1,0 replaced by 0,1,0,1,1 (Bourdon effect on, pressure correction for bends off, Bourdon in the sustained load cases): not writer output, with its own hash (substituted_mbf_text)
